question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Brittle
solution:
The correct answer is '**Resilient**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Brittle**" means easily broken or shattered. (टूटने वाला)
 
• The antonym of "**Brittle**" would be something that is flexible and not easily broken.
 
• "**Resilient**" means able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions. (लचीला)

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The material was resilient__ and did not break under pressure.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Crunchy (कुरकुरा)**: means making a sharp noise when bitten or crushed.
 
• **Delicate (नाज़ुक)**: means easily broken or damaged; fragile.
 
• **Aloof (अलग)**: means not friendly or forthcoming; cool and distant.
